name: slip-and-fall
description: Premises liability (slip and fall) pre-litigation workflow. Emphasizes fast evidence preservation (video is often overwritten within days) and Georgia PI/ante litem deadlines.

deadlines.label: Ante Litem Notice — State of Georgia

tasks.name: Screening interview: where, how, and why the fall happened; hazard and notice facts
Run conflict check against property owner, manager, and tenant
Attorney go/no-go decision on liability and notice
Send and execute contingency fee agreement and HIPAA authorizations
GOVERNMENT PROPERTY — ante litem required; escalate to attorney TODAY
Send spoliation letter demanding preservation of surveillance video and incident report (video is often overwritten within days)
Send Letter of Representation to property owner and its insurer
Request incident/accident report and any 911/EMS records
Photograph the hazard, scene, footwear, and injuries; return for daylight/condition photos
Identify and interview witnesses and store employees
Investigate prior similar incidents / hazard history at the location
Confirm client is treating; set up provider and diagnosis tracking
Monthly client check-in until MMI
Confirm MMI / release from care
Request all medical records and itemized bills (HIPAA)
Identify liens and calculate total special damages
Assemble demand package and draft valuation for attorney review
Attorney approves demand; send and calendar response deadline
Track adjuster response; document offers; get written client authority before accepting
Attorney reviews release; resolve liens; prepare disbursement for approval
